title: Establish protected authority and complete importer/reconciliation
evidence: P0 forensic incident cause NOT VERIFIED; architecture sections 7–10; Phase 2/2B operational import BLOCKED. No real inventory authorized.
state: Synthetic 28-entity mapping exists; protected source inventory, complete operational importer and final reconciliation NOT IMPLEMENTED.
impact: Wrong-generation adoption or omitted unknown files can lose accounts/content despite passing synthetic tests.
acceptance: In an approved protected environment produce a signed immutable source manifest and identity/key-domain evidence; enumerate every source path without defaulting unknowns; importer dry-run and candidate round-trip must match every identity, field, null/absence, nested order, relationship and media digest. Any unexplained mismatch blocks activation; zero automatic repairs or secret replacement.
tests: Invented malformed/unknown/duplicate/equal-count-different-membership cases first; protected inventory and frozen final reconciliation only after separate approval.
productionRelevance: Mandatory before any real migration; historical incident attribution may remain uncertain but current authority/membership may not.

title: Prove independent recovery and current-state application rollback
evidence: Phase 2B reclassifies cold reconnect as not a new-host restore; restore/adoption tooling absent; local export is not PITR.
state: Frozen encrypted synthetic export tested; operational SQL restore, independent recovery generation and full reverse export NOT IMPLEMENTED.
impact: A successful database commit is insufficient if database, keys or media cannot be recovered after a host/storage failure.
acceptance: Restore independent SQL backup/PITR plus media and original key domains onto a clean authorized fixture host; verify all membership/content/media digests, existing sessions and active/pending 2FA; measure recovery within signed RPO/RTO. Interrupt each activation step and retry safely. Demonstrate rollback to a prior application build against current SQL state; refuse stale JSON rollback after writes.
tests: Synthetic fresh-host restore, lost/corrupt catalog, unavailable escrow, partial promotion, interrupted retry, same-count old generation, post-write app rollback and operator tabletop; protected drill requires approval.
productionRelevance: Mandatory recovery gate; no mock may substitute for hosted restore.

title: Certify hosted PostgreSQL and least-privilege identities
evidence: Current isolation is owned local PostgreSQL; architecture explicitly lacks hosted HA/PITR/role certification. Official platform docs consulted, not account-specific configuration.
state: Development adapter exists and is deliberately deployment-fenced; production connection/roles/TLS NOT TESTED.
impact: Development owner privileges and local-cluster persistence cannot establish production confidentiality, durability or supported deployment compatibility.
acceptance: Approve supported provider, region, schema workflow and connection limits; separate app, migration and backup identities. Verify certificate/hostname TLS policy and reject invalid certificates; app identity must fail DDL, role escalation and unauthorized schemas while passing approved operations. No database-superuser runtime. Test network outage/reconnect and overlap connection budget; no JSON fallback.
tests: Isolated hosted fixture least-privilege deny matrix, TLS negative tests, disconnect/reconnect/failover behavior and supported schema deployment rehearsal.
productionRelevance: Mandatory; no production resource provisioned or queried here.

title: Replace local synthetic media durability with certified hosted semantics
evidence: Phase 2 media bytes live in isolated local root; Phase 2F verifies bytes but not hosted provider. Replit deployment filesystem is not durable.
state: Pending/ready intent, fsync/hash/read and retained media behavior tested locally; production storage integration for SQL implementation NOT IMPLEMENTED.
impact: Posts may survive while images, avatars, videos or archived highlights disappear after republish.
acceptance: Use approved durable bucket/object identity, immutable/versioned references and attach-after-verified-ready protocol; kill between upload/commit/response and retry once without losing bytes. Reconcile all inline/gallery/comment/avatar/highlight references and retained deletions. Cold new-host reads and restored media hashes must match; orphan handling must not delete live references.
tests: Hosted invented CRUD, Range/HEAD, checksum corruption/missing object, provider outage, duplicate attach, interrupted uploads, retention and clean-host restore.
productionRelevance: Mandatory before importing any real media.

title: Enforce old-writer freeze and safe overlapping deployment
evidence: Global SQL lock/epoch tested only among cooperating development workers; legacy mirror and CLI paths are separate authorities. Native writers not activated.
state: Local SQL epoch/advisory serialization and fail-stop guards implemented; cross-release operational cutover/freeze BLOCKED.
impact: A previous deployment or maintenance writer can reintroduce stale state or accept writes outside the selected authority.
acceptance: Enumerate every HTTP/background/CLI writer; enforce freeze and drain, not a voluntary banner. Verify stale epochs and old builds cannot acknowledge a write. Crash between final reconciliation and activation; restart must resume or remain unavailable, never reseed. Under two overlapping builds, admitted commits remain unique and worker retirement cannot mutate later scopes.
tests: Synthetic overlapping releases, stale worker/CLI attempts, queued timers, lost COMMIT response, shutdown drain, activation interruption and refusal to roll back to old JSON.
productionRelevance: Mandatory even for a single VM during replacement; retain existing fences until separately approved replacement.

title: Resolve or formally disposition production uuid advisory and install reproducibility
evidence: Fresh dependency audit: uuid 9.0.1 HIGH GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq. Registry SDK latest 1.0.0 declares storage ^7.7.0; storage latest 8.4.0 outside range. Reviewed gaxios/teeny multipart sites use v4, not vulnerable v3/v5/v6 buffer APIs.
state: Advisory OPEN; narrow v4 reachability evidence is not a fix. Installed npm graph also reports extraneous/invalid edges.
impact: Known integrity vulnerability and uncertain install graph in a persistence dependency.
dependencies: Supported upstream fix or explicitly reviewed replacement
acceptance: Prefer supported parent SDK fix; clean isolated lockfile install must reproduce audited graph and pass API plus hosted storage regressions. Do not force unsupported majors. If no compatible fix exists, release remains blocked unless security/data owners sign a time-bounded exception with demonstrated full reachability analysis, mitigations, owner and expiry.
tests: Fresh dependency audit, clean install, v3/v5/v6 buffer-bound regression if reachable, storage upload/download/delete/error/retry compatibility.
productionRelevance: Mandatory remediation or explicit risk decision; no exception granted here.

title: Complete authenticated browser, stored-XSS, mobile and PWA certification
evidence: Phase 2F NOT TESTED; Phase 2G standard Playwright launch exit 127 missing libglib-2.0.so.0. G04 proves JSON storage only.
state: Public static rendering observed; real authenticated UI actions NOT TESTED.
impact: API correctness does not prove login/navigation, safe content rendering, touch usability or cache update behavior.
dependencies: Working supported browser runner or manual operator
acceptance: Execute every manual checklist row with actual login/2FA and evidence on desktop/mobile in Arabic/English, including negative actions, stored markup, PWA update/offline/logout and original-vs-preview distinction. Zero untriaged security-critical failures; each remaining defect requires explicit signed release disposition.
tests: reports/POSTGRESQL_PHASE2G_BROWSER_CHECKLIST.md; automation may replace manual steps only when actions actually execute.
productionRelevance: Mandatory; screenshots and VM helper tests are not substitutes.

title: Approve and enforce media/avatar audience policy
evidence: G05: invented authenticated upload followed by unauthenticated GET/HEAD succeeds. server.js routes /media before API auth; architecture explicitly leaves policy undecided.
state: Existing known-URL public media behavior reproduced; employee/group-aware policy NOT IMPLEMENTED.
impact: Anyone with a URL can retrieve employee media regardless of post/group/session visibility.
acceptance: Data owner explicitly approves intended visibility per media class. For employee/group-private media, enforce fresh authorization for GET/HEAD/Range/avatar/thumbnail and archived/shared references, or reviewed short-lived access mechanism. Verify revoked member and expired session denial without breaking retained authorized highlights. Public classes require documented consent/retention.
tests: Invented outsider/member/owner/moderator/admin/removed-member and unauthenticated URL tests for all media variants.
productionRelevance: Mandatory policy closure; observed public access is not automatically classified as an implementation BOLA defect without the policy.

title: Certify registration/recovery and required delivery providers
evidence: H04/H25/H29 and B04/B05 test fixture receipts; actual SMTP/SMS/push delivery NOT TESTED.
state: Session/2FA/recovery and transactional synthetic outbox partially tested; hosted delivery BLOCKED.
impact: Employees cannot register/recover accounts; duplicate or missing OTP/notifications can expose or lock accounts.
acceptance: Deliver invented OTP/email/recovery to approved test destinations; verify expiry, replay, concurrent one-time use, failed delivery, bounded retry and no secret logs. Mandatory recovery channel must work before release. Certify push permission, subscription rotation and click target if push ships; otherwise explicitly disable/defer only optional delivery channels with product approval.
tests: Provider sandbox success/outage/timeouts/duplicate receipt; real browser registration, 2FA, reset and push flows using invented identities.
productionRelevance: Mandatory account recovery; optional push/SMS only deferrable if core promised workflows remain functional and owner approves.

title: Certify sensitive response/state retention and abuse limits
evidence: B05/B06/B20 encryption/no-response/expiry controls; G01 no-store; browser tokens stored in localStorage. No current scoped SAST/dataflow scanner available.
state: Encrypted replay/control/outbox and distributed development map serialization implemented; operational retention/log access/backup copies and browser lifetime PARTIALLY TESTED.
impact: Credential responses may persist in replay logs/backups; spoofed forwarding or restarted counters may weaken abuse controls.
acceptance: Approve retention and key/access matrix covering replay, outbox, logs, backups and browser storage. Verify expired sensitive payloads are redacted/removed even during idle periods; no OTP/token/2FA material in observability exports. Test trusted proxy client-IP behavior, multi-process/restart limits, identity limits and maximum queue/body sizes. No auth bypass or silent counter reset.
tests: Ciphertext and expiry/idle-cleanup tests, privilege-denied SQL reads, revoked replay, log redaction, browser logout/cache inspection, forwarded-IP and abuse burst tests.
productionRelevance: Mandatory; no plaintext key/log inspection of real users permitted.

title: Approve release load envelope and close integrated feed limits
evidence: Phase 2D full-feed 20k guard failure; Phase 2F private 20k page ~139MiB does not replace original app. Burst50 accepts32/rejects18; global directory hydration persists.
state: Original full feed implemented; bounded paging PROTOTYPE ONLY. Product/global consumer integration BLOCKED.
impact: Unbounded feed/enrichment/browser state can exhaust resources under expected content/user growth.
dependencies: Approved feed decisions and target dataset/traffic/SLO
acceptance: Owner signs numerical dataset, engagement/directory/media sizes, sustained concurrency, p95/error/admission and RSS/browser budgets. Certify actual original UI/API under that envelope with background jobs and overlap. If it cannot pass, approve/integrate versioned paging and independent global projections with exact parity; never ship private ordinal preview as default-newest. Any narrower controlled release must have enforced limits and explicit business sign-off.
tests: Real-shaped synthetic sustained and full-scroll tests; new/old/top/search/scope/widgets/mutation/restart/dedup/eviction; measure RSS, browser heap/DOM, queues and rejection ratios separately.
productionRelevance: Mandatory capacity evidence; pagination itself is not mandatory if an explicitly bounded original application release is proven adequate.

title: Certify translation quality, failure containment and privacy behavior
evidence: G08–G11 orchestration-only fixtures; actual new probe returns punctuation-heavy Arabic→English, then 768MiB guard at ~776MiB. Prior B22 HTTP positive samples pass. Frontend external web-translate link includes source text.
state: Local OPUS service exists, disabled in ordinary preview; mixed-content model quality, latency and browser behavior NOT CERTIFIED.
impact: Incorrect translation, lost URLs/names, shared-worker memory/deadline failure or unintended employee-text disclosure.
dependencies: Owner-approved quality/latency budget and privacy decision
acceptance: Bilingual reviewers approve rubric and representative invented corpus in both directions, mixed scripts/names/URLs/hashtags/emojis/punctuation/edits. Preserve original stored text and identifiers; explicitly handle unsupported/overlong inputs without silent truncation. Prove model load/inference failure, timeout and queue recovery without unrelated request corruption. External link disclosure must have an approved consent/policy; do not send real content during certification. Release must either meet agreed quality/resource budget or explicitly defer/disable translation with product approval.
tests: Actual model corpus with independent review, measured cold/warm HTTP latency and RSS, stuck/failed model, content-key cache edit invalidation, RTL/LTR and failure UI browser checks.
productionRelevance: Mandatory multilingual feature disposition, not a demand to change models now.

title: Establish readiness, alerting, incident runbook and worker supervision
evidence: Phase 2D fail-stop is a development safety policy, not HA; no hosted alerting/on-call or sustained service measurement.
state: Liveness/readiness and local diagnostics implemented; production supervision/alerts NOT TESTED.
impact: A deadline, DB outage or media/provider failure may leave the platform unavailable without operator notice.
acceptance: Specify restart/drain policy and redact metrics/logs. Trigger and receive alerts for unavailable readiness, worker retirement, DB/pool saturation, backup age/restore failure, storage errors and outbox lag; verify operator acknowledgment and runbook. Prove cold restart and overlap do not reseed or lose acknowledged writes.
tests: Hosted invented fault drills with measured detection/recovery, alert delivery and incident tabletop.

title: Preserve and escrow existing signing/backup/2FA/provider key domains
evidence: P0 repairs forbid implicit regeneration; development provisioning binds both key domains. Real custody/restore not authorized or tested.
state: Invented missing/foreign-key startup refusal tested; real key custody and recovery BLOCKED.
impact: Accounts can remain present while sessions, 2FA or backups become unusable after republish.
acceptance: Approved secure custody and independent recovery escrow preserve existing signing/backup/active+pending 2FA domains without rotation or disclosure. Key identifiers/fingerprints only in evidence; restricted access and recovery ceremony. Missing/foreign key startup must fail without regeneration; approved synthetic restore must retain sessions/factors and decrypt archives.
tests: Invented matching/missing/foreign key and pending-factor recovery drill first; protected custodian-only verification under separate authorization.
productionRelevance: Mandatory; no secret values accessed in this phase.

title: Close route/object authorization and business acceptance coverage
evidence: Prior 56+27+9+11 suites cover many but not all branches; Phase 2B engagement/peek/pin/place-name and some positive variants have no observations. New G02 only samples boundaries.
state: Original handlers integrated; feature and BOLA matrix IMPLEMENTED BUT PARTIALLY TESTED.
impact: Untested actions/aliases may violate employee, moderator, admin, ownership, ban or group boundaries.
acceptance: Create complete method/path/action/op/object-role inventory for included features. Every branch gets successful authorized behavior plus unauthenticated, wrong-owner, removed-member, banned, revoked and lower-role denial as applicable. Verify no side effects on denial and atomic commit-before-success under retry/crash. Defer unsupported external/geocoding actions only explicitly.
tests: Invented per-route role/object matrix including deep links, hidden/reported content, notifications ownership, groups, comments/polls, admin/moderation, 2FA/reset and SQL/malformed input; browser coverage remains REL-007.
productionRelevance: Mandatory release-scope coverage, not a claim every existing handler is vulnerable.

title: Resolve isolated preview zod advisory or keep preview excluded
evidence: Fresh scanner: zod 3.25.76 HIGH GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, proposed fix 4.6.6 major. Direct artifact devDependency; no zod imports found under artifact src.
state: Advisory OPEN in isolated prototype dependency graph; no exploitability established.
impact: Preview validation paths could exhaust memory if affected unbounded collection parsing is reachable; not evidence of root application exposure.
dependencies: Supported compatible fix/removal decision and dependency usage review
acceptance: Confirm advisory applicability and actual call graph; remove unused package or adopt reviewed compatible parent/schema change, then clean install/audit/typecheck/build and preview regression. Never force a major solely to clear scanner. Exclude preview from production serving/build.
tests: Preview dependency/reachability audit and bounded-array failure regression if reachable.
productionRelevance: Optional while development-only and excluded; becomes mandatory if any affected preview validation code ships.

title: Broader native writer and concurrency redesign
evidence: Phase 2C/2D retain global serialization intentionally; only selected native reads and private feed candidate exist.
state: NOT IMPLEMENTED; native write design only.
impact: Potential later throughput/maintainability improvement; unsafe lock removal risks state corruption.
dependencies: Request-scoped mutable state and callback isolation
acceptance: Separate approved proposal and exact race/parity/timeout tests before any writer conversion; retain current gates until replacement proves correctness.
tests: Future scoped concurrency, cancellation, write/write and background/HTTP races.
productionRelevance: Optional architectural solution, not a prerequisite if certified controlled-release envelope passes.

title: Preview visual variations and extra diagnostics
evidence: Phase 2F isolated canvas preview exists; user requested no further prototype expansion.
state: PROTOTYPE ONLY; no further variants started.
impact: Optional usability/presentation refinement, unrelated to account durability.
acceptance: Only undertake after release blockers and explicit scope approval; keep original interface unchanged.
